units.text: INT. FARMHOUSE KITCHEN - HARVEST NIGHT
A long pine table crowded with cornbread, pickled beets, and a pot of paprika stew.
Oil lamps burn though the electricity works.
Through the open window, the throb of a combine in the field, working late.
OLEKSANDR (70s, white moustache, suspenders) sits at the head of the table, carving bread with a knife older than his children.
His wife MIREILLE (60s, floured apron, silver braid) ladles stew into mismatched bowls.
Their son TEDDY (40s, city jacket, gold watch) sits restlessly to the right, thumbing his phone under the table.
His sister ROSA (30s, work gloves tucked into her belt, sunburned neck) leans against the stove with her arms folded.
At the far end, AUGUSTINE (20s, neighbor boy, cap in his hands) waits to be told where to sit.
And in the corner, perched on a milking stool, KIERAN (10, the grandson, scabbed knees, a jar of fireflies) holds the jar in both hands and watches everyone.
Mireille sets a bowl in front of Teddy.
He looks at it as if it were an invoice.
Eat.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: I'm not hungry.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: You haven't been hungry in this house in fifteen years.
units.name: ROSA

units.text: Don't start.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Teddy, we have guests.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Somebody has to start.
units.name: ^ROSA

units.text: Mireille puts the ladle down with a clink.
Augustine edges toward a chair and pretends to be fascinated by the wallpaper.
Kieran lifts his jar of fireflies to the lamp.
The bank called about the loan again.
units.name: ROSA

units.text: I know.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: You know?
units.name: ROSA

units.text: I'm the one who signed it.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Oleksandr's knife stops in the bread.
Mireille touches the edge of her apron.
Nobody speaks.
The combine in the field coughs and goes quiet.
Kieran's fireflies blink.
You signed?
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: For the combine. Papa, I did it for the harvest.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: You put the land on that paper.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: It's a bridge loan. We pay it off in March.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: If the wheat sells.
units.name: ROSA

units.text: It will sell.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Hail came through Tuesday. Forty acres flattened.
units.name: ROSA

units.text: Why am I only hearing about this now?
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Because you only come when there's something to sign.
units.name: ROSA

units.text: Teddy shoves his chair back.
Oleksandr raises one hand.
The room freezes: Rosa with her arms locked, Teddy half-risen, Mireille clutching the ladle, Augustine wide-eyed in the lamplight, Kieran cradling his glowing jar.
Sit down.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Teddy sits.
Oleksandr lays the knife across the loaf, wipes his hands on his trousers, and rises, slow, using the table's edge.
He crosses to the window and stands looking out into the dark.
My father lost this land in forty-six. My brother and I won it back with our hands. It was never ours. It was a loan from the weather.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Oleksandr.
units.name: MIREILLE

units.text: Let me say it. If the bank takes it, the bank takes it. I'm not afraid of a letter.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Papa...
units.name: ROSA

units.text: What I am afraid of is this. A table where nobody tells the truth until the harvest is in.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: He turns.
His eyes find Kieran's.
Boy. What is in your jar?
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Fireflies, Dedo.
units.name: KIERAN

units.text: How many?
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Eleven.
units.name: KIERAN

units.text: Are they happy?
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: They glow when they're scared.
units.name: KIERAN

units.text: A silence.
Then Mireille begins to laugh, hand over her mouth, and then Rosa, and then, unwillingly, Teddy.
Augustine, relieved, sits at last.
Oleksandr crosses back to the table, takes Teddy by the shoulder, and sits beside him.
Eat, my son. Tomorrow we count the wheat that's left.
units.name: OLEKSANDR

units.text: Teddy lifts his spoon.
Kieran sets his jar on the table.
In the glow of eleven small lights, the family eats.
